tables.title: Population in South Korea by provinces, 1940-1948 a/ (thousands)
tables.source_note: Committee on Population and Census Statistics.
footnotes: a/ Korean population only. Data for 1940 and 1944 have been adjusted: (1) to exclude Japanese and other non-Koreans, and (2) for boundary changes at the 38th parallel in Kyonggi-do and Kangwon-do.
b/ Estimates by Committee on Population and Census Statistics.
c/ Adjusted to separate the population of Cheju-do from Cholla-namdo.
d/ The concentration in Seoul of the Japanese in Korea at the time, and their exclusion from these data, make the downward adjustment for Seoul more pronounced than for the rest of South Korea.
